label: Forested parcel (central MA)

species.reason: Site overlaps low-gradient stream corridor, adjacent wetland, nearby trees.
Site provides mature canopy, a large forest block, water for foraging.
Some edge habitat for pollinators; consider on-site planting.

mitigation: Keep a 30 m undisturbed buffer around wetlands and streams.
Avoid clearing mature trees between April and September (bat season).
Plant native pollinator habitat on retained open land.
Cluster the footprint to preserve the largest contiguous forest block.
